name: vc-frontend
description: Working on a Virto Commerce frontend: a fork of the storefront theme (vc-frontend-next or a customer's theme), or a storefront plugin in a backend module. Skills: merge-upstream — brings upstream vc-frontend (dev or a release tag) into the fork, keeping the fork's look and upstream's behavior; port-upstream-to-fork — finds upstream changes the merge did not deliver because the fork replaced or stopped rendering the code, and ports them; mf-new-plugin — makes a backend module ship a storefront plugin: scaffolds it with vc-frontend's generator, edits the module's .csproj, module.manifest and .gitignore, and proves it with check:plugin-module. Can make mistakes: every change needs human review before merging.
